description: ERC-8004 identity registry: which address HOLDS a registration (the token) and which it names as its agentWallet, now and over time, read from the registry’s own logs (Transfer, and MetadataSet with key "agentWallet": set to the registrant on registration, cleared when the token moves, set again only with proof of control). With `address`: every registration that address is joined to and HOW: owner_and_agent_wallet, owner (holds it, the agentWallet is another address or unset), agent_wallet (named agentWallet, another address holds it) or registrant_only (registered it, the token has since moved). With `chain` + `agentId`: that registration’s registrant, holder and agentWallet now (relation same_as_holder | different_from_holder | unset) and the history of changes with blocks and transactions. `state` is read, not_yet_read (the reader has not reached that block: only the registrant is matched, as before) or unavailable. Two addresses in a registry are not a statement of who controls them. FREE.
